montages.audience_pitch: You do NOT want to mess with Juliana. Watch her take everyone down one by one! #revenge #dramatiktok

segments.what_happens: Juliana shows her mud-stained palms while being called a servant.
The thug steps into Juliana's personal space and threatens her.
Juliana looks coldly at Catherine and commands her to act as a scullery maid.
Catherine prostrates herself entirely on the floor before Alexander and Juliana.

montages.cliffhanger_segment_note: Watching the villain completely bow down to the former servant makes viewers want to see how Juliana won.
montages.editorial_rationale: Starts with Juliana being mistreated and builds up to her ultimate power move where the villain begs.

montages.audience_pitch: My heart stopped beating during every single one of these. Too intense! #thriller #mustwatch

segments.what_happens: A blackthorn needle stabs deep into Juliana's hand.
The blond nobleman whispers the word poison with a dark scowl.
Catherine screams silence while raising a branding poker.
The glowing hot iron gets inches from Juliana's eye before the cut.

montages.cliffhanger_segment_note: The hot branding iron right next to the eye is terrifying and forces people to check if she survives.
montages.editorial_rationale: Piling up physical danger scenes hooks viewers through pure adrenaline and fear for the main character.

montages.audience_pitch: When the villain finally snaps, you know chaos is coming. #drama #villain

segments.what_happens: Catherine aggressively yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.
Catherine screams in rage as a hot poker burns a book.
Cathedral doors slam open with armed officers entering.
Catherine's face turns from despair to a cold, triumphant smile.

montages.cliffhanger_segment_note: The sudden switch in Catherine's facial expression makes viewers desperate to know what secret plan she just pulled off.
montages.editorial_rationale: Focuses entirely on the antagonist's mood swings and evil plots to give viewers someone to hate-watch.

discovery_notes: The best moments naturally group around extreme physical danger, characters snapping in rage, and ultimate power reversals. Viewers love seeing the underdog take control after taking abuse from villains.
